thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: Multiple health-check failures from monitoring probes in us-west-2a/us-west-2b. Affected service: inference-edge-router. Alert group: network-probes-us-west-2. Threshold breached 3m ago. Root TS: 1768456789

maya (oncall-sre): I'm on it. pulling up probe dashboard and router metrics.

jon (oncall-sre): pinged. can you confirm which zones? I just saw alerts for .2a and .2b as well.

maya (oncall-sre): yep 2a + 2b. interestingly the cloud-net health collectors show no recent heartbeat from the probe fleet starting ~1768456600.

sarah (cloud-net): I'm watching BGP tables and AZ-to-AZ fabric. not seeing obvious BGP withdraws on our side yet. running traceroutes to the probe IPs.

maya (oncall-sre): quick checks:
```
# curl health
curl -sS https://probe-usw2a-03.internal/health || echo "failed"
# kubectl -n monitoring logs probe-collector-usw2a-03 | tail -n 50
```
curl returned connection timed out. kubectl logs show last entry at ~1768456555, then silence.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback request: probe-agent v3.2 -> rollback to v3.1 queued (initiated by maya).

leo (support): Heads up: a few customers reported elevated latencies in us-west earlier -- support ticket #11284. unclear if related.

maya (oncall-sre): Good flag, leo. I'm going to try SSH to the node, but SSH also times out. Could be a control-plane side issue or a network blackhole inside the AZ.

jon (oncall-sre): If probe VMs are unreachable but cloud provider control plane still responds, could be an AZ-level fabric partition. Sarah, can you check provider incident console / region status?

sarah (cloud-net): Provider console shows a degraded networking event for us-west-2 AZs (internal note: potential ToR/leaf flaps). They've got a ticket open: CP-98123. We should assume partial AZ networking impairment.

maya (oncall-sre): That aligns. Two practical immediate mitigations: 1) suppress the noisy probe alerts to avoid paging storms (they're useless while the AZ is out), 2) reroute production traffic away from the affected AZs if our routing policy can.

jon (oncall-sre): I'll take suppress alerts. maya, can you coordinate reroute with sarah?

maya (oncall-sre): On it. Suppressing alerts:
```
# temporarily silence checks for group network-probes-us-west-2
./monitoring-cli silence --group network-probes-us-west-2 --until +30m --reason "AZ networking event"
```
:sweat_drops: will annotate pager runbook.

sarah (cloud-net): For reroute: updating SmartRouting policy to prefer us-west-1 + us-east-1 for inference-edge-router across customer-facing routes. Applying weighted shift 70/30 away from us-west-2 over 2 mins.

maya (oncall-sre): Doing canary test: switching a small customer tenant to fallback region via feature flag. will monitor for errors.

leo (support): I'm drafting a support status blurb: "We are investigating networking issues affecting a subset of traffic in US-West. Workarounds in progress; some requests may see increased latency. We're not seeing errors for all customers." Will post after ops approval.

maya (oncall-sre): +1 on status. status-bot, please create an incident page and set initial severity to P2.

status-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0453 (P2) — "us-west-2 AZ network degradation causing probe/latency issues". Status: investigating.

jon (oncall-sre): Question: are the monitoring probes themselves showing false positives? We should validate whether probe collector update v3.2 caused heartbeat suppression.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback in progress for probe-agent: rolling back 4 instances in us-west-2a/us-west-2b.

maya (oncall-sre): After rollback attempt, logs still absent. rollback didn't re-establish connectivity to nodes, which points to infra-level outage not agent bug.

sarah (cloud-net): Provider acknowledged a ToR switch flapping in us-west-2a causing intermittent packet drops; their mitigation: replace failing fabric line card. ETA initial fix 25-40m. They report dataplane pathfinding anomalies that can also trigger health-check failures.

maya (oncall-sre): Given ETA, we should keep traffic shifted and move sensitive customers off us-west-2 entirely for the next 1h. Also we should prepare an incident update for customers. leo, can you escalate to support leads to prepare targeted messages?

leo (support): On it. will prepare two versions: brief status + longer technical note for affected enterprise contacts.

jon (oncall-sre): Handing off primary on-call to jon for the next 20m as I need to step into a postmortem prep meeting. I'm still available though. @jon (oncall-sre) you are primary.

jon (oncall-sre): Taking handoff. Summary: provider ToR/flapping; probe collectors unreachable; silence alerts; traffic shifted to fallback regions; status page live; support preparing messages. Will keep watch and escalate if provider ETA slips.

maya (oncall-sre): One more thing — probe telemetry gap means we don't have request-level traces for ~1768456550–1768457000 in affected AZs. This will complicate root cause diagnosis. Logging this for post-incident analysis.

sarah (cloud-net): Adding route metrics snapshot and BGP dump to the incident storage: s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-0453/network-dumps/1768456789.txt

incident-bot: Reminder: please add the incident channel to the DRI rotation for on-call handoff.

jon (oncall-sre): Noted. I'll escalate to provider if ETA > 45m. Also scheduling a follow-up in 15m for status update.

leo (support): Posted initial @customers status update. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-0453

maya (oncall-sre): Quick checklist for the handoff:
- confirm monitoring suppression stays in place
- keep traffic shift policy active until provider confirms stable fabric
- gather any targeted request IDs from support for debugging when telemetry returns
- schedule postmortem once provider confirms root cause

jon (oncall-sre): Acknowledged handoff. I'll keep the incident open and coordinate with sarah + leo. If anything changes (new customer errors, provider update), ping this thread.

sarah (cloud-net): Provider updated: replacement line card shipped, replacement scheduled in 18m. They'll run validation once installed.

jon (oncall-sre): thanks. keeping incident P2 for now. Will update after validation.

maya (oncall-sre): leaving final note before I step out: the missing probe telemetry is the riskiest blindspot — add a follow-up to add cross-region probe redundancy in postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0453 status changed: investigating -> monitoring (mitigation in place). Logged timeline and actions.

jon (oncall-sre): marking this thread for follow-up. will close once provider validates and probes resume.

leo (support): will reopen customer comms if we see errors return.

(End of thread)
